title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (show b- Late?) on 1970-01-02
source: Soundboard > 7 1/2' Reel Master @ 7.5 ips (Recorded By Bear on a Sony 770 Reel Deck) > 1st gen (TDK SAX-100 cassette) from Dick Latvala (Master Reel Playback on a Technics 1506 Reel to Reel > Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck No dolby) > Analog to Digital (Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Sony PCM-R700 DAT @ 44.1 by Jim Wise 1998); Edited and mastered SIRMIck

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with Tom Constanten front‑and‑center, highlighted by a scorching Tighten Up jam and an unforgettable Dark Star despite occasional bass muffling.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its free‑form fire—especially the incendiary Tighten Up sequence and a soaring Dark Star that many fans rank among the best of 1970. The soundboard source is generally crisp and well‑balanced, though Phil’s bass can be buried in the mix. Overall the performance and recording earn high marks from the community.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (most reviewers highlight jams and song moments) combined with a very good soundboard source; only minor issues like buried bass keep it from the top tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is clear with Tom Constanten prominent; reviewers note great overall fidelity, though one points out Phil’s bass is hard to hear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts strong with tight harmonies, moves into a spacey Dark Star that some find minimalistic, then builds momentum through fiery jams like Feelin' Groovy and Tighten Up.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass can be difficult to hear in this mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for his talented guitar work and a notable solo during the Tighten Up sequence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) is pushed forward in the mix, giving keyboards a prominent presence.
